description: Create the OTPCODE table if missing; add WebUser.TWOFACTORSETUPWINDOWSTARTEDAT
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
note: The OtpCode entity (SMS login codes) had no migration, so a database that did not get the table from elsewhere fails every SMS code request. The WebUser entity now maps twoFactorSetupWindowStartedAt; every query that loads a WebUser fails without the column. Run this before deploying a build that includes this change. Idempotent; changes no data.
